TennisContent: The use of the courts for activities unrelated to the corresponding sports is prohibited.
Wearing inappropriate footwear that may damage the court surface is not allowed.
The maximum court usage time is 1 hour if other residents are waiting.
Consumption of food or beverages (except water) is not allowed on the courts.
Personal sports equipment must be used responsibly and removed after use.
GrillContent: The barbecue area must be reserved in advance with the condominium administration.
The area must be kept clean after use, including the removal of trash and food waste.
Ambient sound must comply with moderate volume regulations to avoid disturbing other residents.
Glass containers are not allowed in the barbecue area.
The use of the barbecue area is restricted to residents and their guests. Large-scale events are not permitted without prior authorization.

GrillRentWarning: Attention: When renting the grill area, you are also renting the party hall and the sports court.

TablesAndChairsAgreement.Title: RESPONSIBILITY TERM FOR TABLES AND CHAIRS
TablesAndChairsAgreement.Content: I, [userName], unit/apartment No. [userApartment], resident at Condomínio Chácara Sacopã, declare that I am aware of and agree with the terms listed below for the temporary use of tables and chairs belonging to the condominium.

Sections.title: 1. OBJECT
Sections.content: 1.1. This term aims to formalize the temporary withdrawal of condominium tables and chairs for the private use of the above-identified resident.

Sections.title: 2. QUANTITY WITHDRAWN
Sections.content:
2.1. I inform that I am withdrawing:
• 12 Tables
• 48 Chairs

Sections.title: 3. CONDITIONS OF USE AND RETURN
Sections.content:
3.1. The tables and chairs withdrawn will be used exclusively on the condominium premises, for private purposes. Under no circumstances may they be given to third parties or used improperly.
3.2. The items must be returned, in perfect condition, at the end of the event, in order to enable possible use by other residents.
3.3. The resident is responsible for damages, losses or misplacements, bearing the costs of repair or replacement.

Sections.title: 4. RESPONSIBILITY
Sections.content:
4.1. Failure to comply with this term may result in administrative sanctions by the condominium.
4.2. This term becomes a pre-notification for possible infractions related to the subject.

Sections.title: 5. SIGNATURE
Sections.content: 5.1. I declare that I am aware of and agree with all the clauses of this term.
